texts: meridian 59 but in unity engine this game will always have a special place in my heart and i recently started diving into the source code before deciding to experiment for feasible it would be to create a modern fully 3d client and render the game world in unity im not a c developer so i figured i would probably have more success creating a networking layer that parses the packets sent by the server and recreating the c structs in c to work with rather than trying to wrap my head around a completely new and much more difficult programming language im pretty happy with the results i was able to connect authenticate and play on a shiny new client with zero changes to the server code although my graphical skills are severely limited so i grabbed an asset pack off the unity store to try and recreate the world as close to the original as possible which of course means it has lost a lot of its charm so far what works sort of works and is yet to be implemented is as follows works connection handshake and encryption can successfully connect and maintain connection indefinitely movement can move around the world freely and this movement will also be shown to other connected clients i had to map the m59 server location to the unity 3d space which wasnt as straight forward as i expected but after much testing with a couple of connected clients one original and one unity i managed to nail it down changing roomslocation can move between the different locations out of those that have maps that have been created in unity combat can attack and cast spells with basic targetting in place sort of works chat chat works great both chat and system messages are received and displayed currently only sending messages through the say channel works but this wont be a big change to implement it just hasnt been a priority yet displaying other characters mostly works but there is only a selection of 2 character models so everybody looks the same depending on gender also due to how the original client differentiates between players objects and monsters basically it doesnt i had to get creative with identifying player characters and this has led to some oddities like logoff ghosts and corpses being identified as players movement works great but no animations have been implemented yet room generator i created a tool that parsed the roo files of the base game and recreates them in unity it works perfectly for creating a room layout which can then be built off and replaced with a new room to ensure it matches those on the server all the walls and exits will be where they should be however the generated rooms have their textures poorly mapped and it generates a new texture for every surface making it very resource intensive to display and not viable to use for gameplay so these rooms can only act as a baseline to build from raza the starting area is fully explorable but lacking polish and finishing touches and the mausoleum has some areas where i accidentally deleted the collision meshes so you will just fall into oblivion yet to be implemented every other area basically however raza did not take long and i am getting ever quicker with unity so it would certainly be possible to recreate the entire game world one step at a time platforms doors and levers any moving platforms or doors such as guild hall doors the mausoleum door locked by the two levers those pillars enroute to castle brax if memory servers correctly have not yet been implemented i cant see this being much of an issue to add though guilds factions etc havent got this far yet shopstrade havent got this far yet but it is coming up on this list character creation and selection currently you have to have an existing character and it will start the game with your first character day and night cycle whilst this is handled by the server the client is of course responsible for rendering the sky and lighting as a result of messages sent from the server animations and effects this maybe a job for the asset store as animation and particle effects are not in my skillset future potential this is just one of my pet projects that i will run with for awhile and im not sure whether i wll expand it outside of raza yet just a bit of a tribute to the game that largely set me on the path down the career route i find myself on today aside from the obvious benefits of improved graphics there is room for some other additionsimprovements clientside physics the server has no concept of verticality or gravity but we could still use the physics engine for other stuff like special effects fire spells falling leaves running water seemless zone transitions currently i am loading the room the player is in and all adjacent rooms for quicker load times this could be extended to let the player actually see into the next room and walk from zone to zone with no jarring loading of the next areaalthough the contents of the room are sent by the server when entering so they wouldnt be able to see players monsters objects in the next room until walking over the threshold im confident this could be added with some server side changes though cross platform i havent used unity to deploy to other platforms yet but it seems it isnt outside the realms of possibility meridian 59 on mobile or console or even in vr would be an interesting experience im sure server agnostic i considered completing the world zones and distributing it for use so server owners could allow people to use it on their own servers as it works without the need to make any modifications to the server code it could in theory be used to play on any server where the owners want to add support but im not really sure how many servers are still out there any more and anything outside of the base game would not work without expanding the client adding client customisation for server owners to add their own new items npcs zones etc would be a whole new challenge anyway thats all for now thanks for listening to my ted talk

devlog 2 ui art updates well i know its not been that long since my last post but ive been hard at work for the last few days and i wanted to share some new ui and art changes ive been making following some really helpful feedback on rincrementalgames to tell the truth i had a couple of these refinements in the works already and the feedback from reddit just helped me pick an approach and have a clearer picture of everything overhauled ui and styling following feedback i took an honest look at the games ui and made some significant changes i hadnt been super happy with it myself for a while but id been working by the approach of getting the content and gameplay right first then visual design can come later desktop and mobile views here are some of the big refinements ive made cleanersimpler colours and removaltoning down of excessive glow effects trying to make the ui look more gamelike rather than like a business system redesigned header with centralised resource blocks and more defined news tickerprogress bar rows also added a muteunmute button to the right side to prevent you needing to go into settings to turn off sounds good for browser tab idling especially when youre supposed to be working redesigning the tower roomsupgrades to stack vertically and be much more compact while having a cleaner purchase interface better contrast and reduction of number of cards and those always having the same rounded borders to avoid comparisons with common aivibe coded designs i took a new look at my styling and decided to reduce extreme rounding of so many cards and now have a blend of cleanersharper containers with flat colours and trying to rely less on card spam to present things removal of the game title i realised that when i think about it you dont need to see the game title all the time it wasnt needed and was taking up valuable ui space so its now been removed and instead thats where prestige counters and other info will live dynamic tap button one of the newer features ive been developing is this idea of a dynamic clicktap button rather than just a boring old button that makes numbers tick up slightly faster every so often you get a small chance to get a crit tap which is worth much more than a regular tap then each crit has a small chance to trigger mana flow state which is a 5 second rapid tap window where every tap is worth double your base i really like this feature and may look at other ways to augment that tap button perhaps based on certain choices or bonuses youll be able to further increase the crit chance and mana flow window time so its also fully upgradeable arcane tower is by no means a clicker game in fact you can progress just fine without this but it just speeds everything up for you tap buttons tap tap tap dimension exploration animations these were already built into the game but ive been refining the different dimension artwork and key themes flavour text is still something thats on my list to refine but its going to come a bit later exploring new dimensions these windows will scroll smoothly from right to left as you explore giving you more feedback rather than just a progress bar the whole design of my exploration mechanic is that it starts off as an active system with short exploration times but later on as later dimensions take longer to explore it also works as an idle system with an autoexplore feature the animated windows are built in react maybe its not the best way of doing something like this but id gone down the rabbit hole and was able to get some nice effects i might eventually replace these with scrolling pixel art so its something potentially to bring to the game later character customisation theres already a customisable spellbook in the game but if im being honest i dont really like it so ive decided to build in new character customisation elements so you can really personalise your journey i actually draw pixel art as a hobby so im going to be designing some character art and youll be able to shape your mage to your preference i already have name customisation in the game and im working now to incorporate those choices into the game so you see your portrait and name when characters communicate with you and when key story elements are triggered customise your own face shop features i know ingame purchases are always a controversial topic but i wanted to share just a little bit about what im building my approach as with other incremental games is that any purchases are just progress boosts theres nothing here that you need to purchase to progress in the game or unlock the story etc the shop will just be to support the game while also getting some cool unlocks keep going some of the features i have are this cute little golem helper who will wander back and forth across your screen in place of the news ticker shouting encouraging phrases at you there are around 50 different phrases that can appear itll also help you auto tap the main button to increase your mana generation also in the game are a goblin manager which will double your production permanently also with a little animated character a floating infinity orb pet a golden tower theme a unique creature and armour set and further increases to your offline resource generation whats next character pixel art needs to be created and incorporated into the game im hoping to have this in by the time playtesting opens up but it may end up being a release feature end game design and finishing touches still continue balance this is such a time consuming one and something ive really struggled with trying to get this right so that you dont get bored at the start of the game but you also dont just steamroll ahead and end up using none of the automation features unlocked systems etc this will be the key thing that playtesters help me with i need to rework the light mode considering the new ui design music is fine but it needs an overhaul im starting to work in tonejs now to achieve a better sound than just using oscillators hopefully by the time playtest is open the music will be improved theres plenty more to do aside from this but thats just a flavour of where im heading next the next devlog will probably cover endgame in a bit more detail and look into some of the guidance features ive built in thanks for reading see you next time

why some couples grow together while others drift apart the sciencebased psychology that actually works you ever notice how some couples just seem to get each other more as time goes on like theyre aging in reverse getting more in sync more connected more alive together meanwhile others who seemed crazy in love just fade they become roommates polite strangers sharing a netflix account ive been diving deep into this question because i watched it happen around me friends who were obsessed with each other now sit at dinner in total silence my own past relationships felt like slow motion car crashes like we were both trying but somehow moving in opposite directions so i went down a research rabbit hole books psychology podcasts relationship studies therapist interviews the whole thing turns out whether couples grow together or drift apart isnt random luck or compatibility its actually about specific predictable patterns heres what i found step 1 stop treating growth like a solo mission most people think personal growth is an individual thing you level up you work on yourself you become better cool but heres the kicker when youre in a relationship individual growth without shared growth is basically a ticking time bomb research from relationship expert dr john gottman shows that couples who thrive dont just support each others goals they create shared meaning systems thats fancy talk for building a life together that actually matters to both of you shared dreams shared rituals shared inside jokes that make zero sense to anyone else when one person is grinding toward their dream and the other person is just along for the ride thats when the gap starts youre literally moving at different speeds toward different destinations no wonder you drift action item sit down with your partner and ask what do we want to build together not just where do you see yourself in 5 years but where do we see us create shared goals even small ones learn a language together start a side project plan a trip that excites both of you growth has to be a team sport step 2 curiosity doesnt die you kill it heres a brutal truth couples dont drift because they fell out of love they drift because they stopped being curious about each other you think you know your partner you assume youve figured them out so you stop asking questions you stop exploring psychologist esther perel talks about this in her book mating in captivity she says the biggest killer of desire and connection is certainty when you think you know everything about someone theres no mystery no intrigue just boring predictability and boring is the relationship graveyard but heres the thing people change your partner isnt the same person they were 5 years ago hell theyre not even the same person they were last month new fears new dreams new shit theyre dealing with if youre not checking in youre missing the updates action item ask your partner weird open ended questions whats something youve been thinking about lately that you havent told me whats a fear you have that you dont talk about if you could restart one thing in your life what would it be stay curious like youre meeting them for the first time over and over again step 3 conflict isnt the problem avoidance is people think happy couples dont fight wrong happy couples fight all the damn time the difference they fight productively couples who drift apart dont necessarily have more conflict they just handle it like shit they avoid hard conversations they let resentment build they say im fine when theyre absolutely not fine dr sue johnson creator of emotionally focused therapy found that the couples who stay connected are the ones who can repair after conflict they dont avoid the mess they clean it up together they apologize they own their part they dont let wounds fester meanwhile drifting couples they rug sweep they pretend problems dont exist until one day they wake up and realize theyre strangers action item stop avoiding hard conversations if something bothers you say it but say it without attacking use i feel statements instead of you always accusations and when your partner brings something up dont get defensive listen like their feelings actually matter because they do step 4 novelty isnt optional its essential your brain is wired to crave novelty thats why new relationships feel electric everything is new new conversations new places new experiences but over time you fall into routines same restaurants same couch same everything and your brain goes meh psychologist arthur aron did this famous study where he had couples do novel exciting activities together rock climbing learning to dance trying something theyd never done before the result those couples reported significantly higher relationship satisfaction than couples who did boring routine stuff you dont fall out of love you bore yourself out of it action item inject novelty into your relationship like its medicine try new things together go somewhere youve never been take a class do something that scares you both a little break the routine before the routine breaks you step 5 emotional bids are everything this one blew my mind gottman talks about emotional bids which are basically tiny requests for connection your partner says look at that bird thats a bid theyre not really talking about the bird theyre saying connect with me right now you can respond in 3 ways turn toward engage show interest turn away ignore stay distracted turn against be dismissive or hostile gottman found that couples who stay together respond positively to bids 86 of the time couples who split only 33 thats it thats the difference tiny moments of connection repeated over and over when you ignore those bids scroll past them on your phone grunt instead of engage youre building distance one ignored bid at a time action item pay attention to your partners bids when they talk put your phone down look at them respond even if its something small those moments add up to everything step 6 individual identity fuels connection counterintuitive as hell but couples who grow together maintain strong individual identities youre not just we youre also me when people lose themselves in a relationship they get resentful they feel suffocated they blame their partner for their own lack of growth perel says desire needs space you cant want someone whos always there whos become an extension of you you need separateness to fuel connection if youre looking to build both individual growth and relationship skills simultaneously theres depth from quick 10minute overviews to 40minute deep dives with concrete examples and you can choose different voice styles depending on your mood it connects insights from multiple sources books therapist interviews psychological studies so youre getting a fuller picture rather than scattered advice action item keep your own hobbies your own friendships your own goals dont abandon yourself for the relationship be someone your partner can discover not someone theyre stuck with step 7 gratitude over criticism this ones simple but most people fuck it up couples who drift apart focus on whats wrong what their partner didnt do what annoyed them what disappointed them their brain becomes a complaint machine couples who grow together focus on whats right they notice the good stuff they express gratitude they appreciate effort even imperfect effort gottmans research shows you need a 51 ratio of positive to negative interactions to keep a relationship healthy five compliments appreciations or positive moments for every one criticism or complaint action item say thank you more notice the small things your partner does text them something you appreciate about them retrain your brain to see the good instead of hunting for problems look relationships arent magic theyre not destiny or soulmates or meant to be theyre built brick by brick conversation by conversation choice by choice couples grow together when they choose each other every single day not just once at the altar or the first i love you the ones who drift they stopped choosing they got comfortable they assumed love was enough its not love is the starting point not the finish line so ask yourself are you choosing your partner today or are you just coasting because coasting is how you wake up one day plucky realism alternative resting rules hello everyone ive been dming 5e for a few years and im about to run curse of strahd and for that campaign i decided to try and use an experimental set of rules for resting that i came up with after trying both regular rest rules and gritty realism now my suggestion is to create a system that acts as a compromise between base rules and gritty realism lets say plucky realism by implementing three levels of resting short rest lasts 1 hour requires a space devoid of immediate dangers and recharges all the usual raceclass features that recharge on short rest however the pcs can only spend a maximum number of hit dice to regain hp equal to their proficiency bonusso 2 for levels 14 3 for levels 58 4 for levels 912 etc long rest lasts 8 hours requires a relatively safe space like a camp and recharges all the usual raceclass features that recharge on a long rest however the pcs do not refill all hp nor regain hit dice rather they can spend as many hit dice as they want to heal themselvesand features that increase healing during short rests like a bards song of rest apply here too and it only removes 1 level of exhaustion full rest lasts 7 days requires a fully protected area away from danger like a town or village and fully refills both hp and spent hit dice along with removing all levels of exhaustion furthermore during a full rest the pcs can engage in downtime activities the reason is that while i generally prefer the base rulespartially because my players group doesnt work well with gritty realism rules and personally i dont think that dd 5e works as a game system for gritty realism in general id prefer the pcs to feel less unstoppable for this horror campaign and furthermore i want to better implement downtime activities in the games flow so that the players have more chances to interact with the world outside of exploring and fighting what do you think

what if stolas had a psychoanalysis watching helluva boss the character of stolas really caught my attention he is a character with biographical and emotional depth and i thought i would analyze the prince of goetia from a psychological or more strictly speaking psychoanalytical point of view i hope you find this post interesting enjoy lets explore all of stolas relationships i will proceed as follows stolas and the nobility of goetia blitzstolas relationship the sexual relationship the relationship with his daughter octavia stolas and paimon the crucial distinction between helluva boss and hazbin hotel a brief schizoanalytic overview conclusions 1 stolas and the nobility of goetia if we imagine stolas on lacans couch french psychoanalyst and philosopher the diagnosis cannot be that of a subject who entirely coincides with his role prince of goetia on the contrary what emerges is the presence of a repressed authentic self not in the naively psychological sense of a hidden true self but as that desire that finds no place in the context of hell available symbolic stolas is certainly hyperinscribed in the infernal noble law but this inscription does not exhaust his subjectivity his suffering is not the enjoyment of one who coincides with power but rather the effect of a fracture between what he has been appointed to be and what he desires to be without knowing how the problem is not the absence of desire but the absence of a world in which that desire can be articulated without immediately translating into guilt or contradiction 2 blitzstolas relationship the relationship with blitz cannot be reduced to a simple internal outlet within the system blitz is certainly the cause of stolas desire in j lacans psychoanalysis blitz is the object a but it is also something more it is the concrete embodiment of a life that is not genealogical not aristocratic not ordered by the paradigm imposed by paradise keep this detail in mind of guilt and punishment through blitz stolas really tries to trace a line of escape to evade not a successful escape not a revolutionary break but a genuine attempt to get out of the symbolic cage that defines him the fact that this attempt is contradictory mediated by power ill give you the grimoire and then you know what to do and doomed to failure does not make it false it makes it tragic we call tragic that condition in which conflict cannot be resolved through moral choice or individual action because it is inscribed in the structure of the world stolas does not use power out of sadism or cynicism but because he has never had access to a desire that was not already codified by the hierarchy he does not know how to desire otherwise and this is not his fault but structural trauma 3 the sexual relationship sex in this context remains ambiguous on the one hand it is charged with guilty jouissance that is as lacan would say it does not produce a relationship it does not establish reciprocity it does not fill the void on the other hand it is one of the few spaces in which stolas attempts to experience his own body and desire outside of its purely noble function here too failure should not be read as complicity with domination but as the effect of a world in which the alternative is not historically available this too is an important detail transgression does not become an act not because stolas rejects it but because there is no symbolic other who can bear the consequences there seems to be no alternative 4 the relationship with his daughter octavia this limitation emerges strongly in his relationship with his daughter octavia is not only the locus of guilt but also the concrete sign that stolas suffering is not abstract he is a victim of a system but he is not the only victim his pain is transmitted inscribed in other lives however recognizing this does not imply blame does stolas not have a position from which he can protect his daughter without at the same time reproducing the order that hurts her because he is a nobleman not exactly but first and foremost stolas is an inhabitant of hell his paternal impotence is not moral it is structural here helluva boss starkly reveals a tragic truth when the world order is closed even love becomes insufficient as a principle of transformation 5 stolas and paimon the ultimate issue remains the relationship with the father and with genealogy paimon embodies the nameofthefather in almost pure form a law that does not allow negotiation which precedes the subject and defines it entirely stolas did not symbolically kill his father not because he lacked courage but because the world in which he lives does not allow such a killing as a founding event of a new order the father is not just a figure to be overcome he is the pillar of a cosmos that finds its first cause in paradise there we are i told you in the previous parts about two details to keep in mind and now we understand why hell in helluva boss is not the origin of evil but a punitive derivation of a higher order violence is not contingent it is theological 6 the crucial distinction between helluva boss and hazbin hotel this is the decisive point that distinguishes helluva boss from hazbin hotel in the former there is no alternative the system can only be exposed never overcome in the latter however the alternative of redemption appears the possibility that the heavenly order is false and that damnation is not necessary to demand from stolas what charlie attempts to do would be to attribute to him a freedom that his world does not grant 7 a brief schizoanalytic overview from a schizoanalytic perspective all this should not be interpreted as individual failure but as the capture of flows of desire the problem is collective stolas lines of flight exist but they close up because they cannot find assemblages capable of sustaining them blitz is a real but fragile deterritorialization a point of escape from order the family is a forced reterritorialization a return to order the nobility is a machine of total codification desire is not false it is impeded 8 conclusions in conclusion stolas is neither in favor to domination nor someone who enjoys his own imprisonment he is a person who suffers in a world where suffering is the only form of truth available helluva boss does not ask us to judge its characters but to look at what happens when the alternative has been eliminated from the outset in this sense stolas remains a tragic and authentic figure not because he fails morally but because he lives in a world that does not allow him to succeed

fish are incredibly intelligent creatures many people often assume that fish are unintelligent machines or automata that act with no emotion when all scientific evidence clearly show the complete opposite as being true i will now explain how fish are not only intelligent but also are capable of self awareness and understanding abstract concepts 1 fish demonstrate episodic like memory what is episodic memory it is the ability that allows us to remember specific experiences and events from the past including the what the when and the where this often includes mental time traveling to past events this is something that is quite difficult to infer from behavioral experiments since it is a highly privatepersonal experience humans can simply report what they are experiencing unlike animals but we have established experiments with robust controls which specifically ascertain whether if animals can rememberthe what where and the when fish or more specifically zebra fish have been able to demonstrate this ability in a behavioral experiment in this study zebra fish demonstrated the ability to remember which object was seen in which location and in which context which is inferred by the fact that fish showed increased exploration when a familiar object was present in a different location for the same context 2 fish demonstrate self awareness fish are able to demonstrate a basic form of self awareness not the deeply reflective form of self awareness that we see in humans but still significant enough to count as self awareness this study shows fish or specifically cleaner wrasse fish being able to pass the mirror mark test a classic test used to demonstrate self awareness in animals they also demonstrated aggression to photos of similar fish of the same species but did not demonstrate any aggression to its own photo another study corroborated these findings with stricter controls this study shows that fish upon being shown their own reflection analyze their body size and use that to guide their own behavior prior to being shown its reflection fish demonstrated aggression to unfamiliar fish of different body sizes after passing the mirror mark test fish were much more reluctant to engage aggressively towards the photos of the unfamiliar fish that were larger than itself but were aggressive to smaller fish 3 fish demonstrate basic problem solving skills this is a detour task in this task fish across multiple species had to learn alternative routes to treats that were visibly blocked by a barrier this shows that fish were able to inhibit themselves from driving straight towards the transparent barrier that is blocking the treats learn alternative routes where the treats were not visible and moved them away from the treats and kept a specific goal in mind consume the treats that paid off later this demonstrates that fish are capable of basic object permanence and being able to learn different routes to reach their goals without reinforcement 4 fish use tools fish have demonstrated the ability to use tools to crack open shells fish have used anvils to crack open shells of shelled prey this has been documented many times with video evidence across several species and whats more interesting is that these behaviors are not present in all populations of the same species 5 fish understand numbers while fish have not demonstrated the ability to count numbers or symbolically represent them in their minds fish have demonstrated an approximate number system they demonstrate basic numerosity and can represent quantities archer fish are able to demonstrate understanding of different quantities in this experiment archer fish were shown 2 canvases that contained a number of dots they were trained to shoot a jet of water at the canvas that had the most amount of dots and were given a reward if they did so even after adjusting for all possible confounding variables like dot size brightness etc the fish still managed to pass whats more interesting is that fish struggled to distinguish between the amount of dots on the 2 canvases if they were very similar in quantity 6v7 7v8 but were able to perform well when they drastically differed in quantity 4v8 3v7 which indicates an internal representation of number ratios this study demonstrates that cichlids and stingrays are able to add and subtract 1 in the number space from 1 to 5 indicating a very basic understanding of arithmetics this shows that fish have an understanding of basic abstract concepts 6 fish have view invariant object recognition in this study fish were able to recognizedistinguish between a pair of photos of human faces that were rotated at several angles they were able to identify whether if a human face was the same or not even when it was rotated at different angles this shows that fish are able to internalize the identity of an object and generalize it across different orientations of the same object which also demonstrates abstraction there is so much more i can mention but this post is already too long based on what ive researched i can confidently say that fish are genuinely very intelligent and underestimated they demonstrate cognitive abilities that are on par with or even exceed certain mammals and whats even more shocking is that they have very small brains that are at best a few 100 milligrams in weight and are small even relative to their body size

tips for healthy mental health life by design therapy many of us have been conditioned to judge or suppress our emotions mistaking them for weaknesses instead of the wisdom they hold however when we take the time to reframe how we see them emotions become valuable tools for growth and understanding heres why this shift matters curiosity over judgment when you approach emotions with curiosity youre inviting selfcompassion into the process instead of labeling an emotion as bad or wrong curiosity allows you to explore its purpose without shame or guilt messages not problems emotions are your bodys way of saying hey something needs attention here ignoring or suppressing them often leads to bigger issues like stress or burnout when you listen to their message you take the first step toward healing your bodys language emotional awareness often starts in the body whether its a tight chest a racing heart or a lump in your throat these sensations are clues learning to connect these physical sensations to your emotions is a powerful tool for processing and release when you take time to listen and respond to them you create space for healing growth and selfunderstanding to learn more about emotions and how to process them check out my blog a guide to recognizing and processing your emotions when you were never taught how the link to read is in my bio

progress comes from planning routes choosing missions carefully and living with the consequences of those choices the kind of pacing that many older space games had where time distance and preparation actually mattered at first it felt like a small experiment something personal but as systems began to connect missions navigation economy exploration the game slowly gained weight decisions mattered more than reflexes longterm thinking became more important than momenttomoment action thats when i realized i wanted to take it all the way to release i didnt really know how to do things properly promotion happened late some opportunities were missed entirely the demo was released at an awkward time if theres a checklist for launching a game i probably filled it in backward still the game found its audience players who enjoy thinking a few steps ahead players who like planning efficient routes weighing risk versus reward and slowly expanding their reach across a star map rather than conquering it overnight from my perspective that alone made the project a success not because of scale or sales numbers but because the game rewards patience and foresight players engage with systems instead of chasing speed the full development cycle was completed and shipped the universe feels coherent even in its quieter moments one unexpected outcome was how the world itself grew small bits of lore meant to support gameplay started connecting into something larger stories emerged naturally from systems and player actions eventually leading to written stories set in the same universe looking back making this game felt a lot like playing it slow progress occasional wrong turns small optimizations over time and eventually a finished journey for players who enjoy space games where strategy solitude encounter and the failure of belonging hi everyone im new to existentialism philosophy as a general subject and related discussions this is a short philosophical sketch i wrote while working on a conceptual music project it explores solitude not as an identity or essence but as something constructed through relational failure and unmet normative expectations im not trying to make a definitive claim or a therapeutic statement im mainly interested in conceptual clarity and philosophical consistency so id really appreciate critical feedback objections or references that could challenge or refine this approach thanks for taking the time to read it as the human being is a social being solitude is not a neutral void nor a stage of being it is a point of friction constructed through lived experience it is not merely the absence of company but the lack of a supposedly intrinsic and attributed human condition it is the misalignment between what one is and what one is expected to be when the axiom functions as a foundation rather than as a description encounter is neither a right nor a consequence it is better understood as a contingent event depending on precedent origin or timing individuals may remain outside what is established not every form of society is beneficial not every form of company sustains and not every bond is habitable the solitude that emerges from failed encounter is not inevitable it is constructed its pillars are failed attempts repetition and the experience of nonbelonging there is no identifiable error only uncertainty regarding what socialization itself represents lived experience produces changes before any moral lesson reflection or immediate understanding can take place it opens the space for construction the subject does not freely choose how these experiences are organized they are structured through already sedimented dispositions within this framework three broad positions can be identified in relation to solitude the hardened the flexible and the fragile the hardened subject turns solitude into a defensive posture they protect themselves by hardening resent the social and withdraw from what fails to accommodate them convinced that the world does not fit society is a superficial structure in which i do not want to take part the flexible subject does not convert solitude into identity they coexist with it expand their selfperception and remain critical without absolutizing failure they preserve intact aspects of themselves while recognizing the cost of failed attempts society is a complex environment and variables must be identified in order to meet within it the fragile subject lives under the direct weight of the axiom the need for connection becomes primary over any other condition of encounter they remain in company as long as it lasts until misalignment becomes unavoidable within this tension each new attempt risks either momentary relief or further fracture often without prior evaluation society is so closely tied to being human that belonging feels obligatory otherwise something must be wrong with me none of these positions is morally superior they are different responses to the same pressure and they may even alternate depending on context exhaustion or time what remains afterward is not necessarily hope or resignation it is persistence a minimal form of implication that promises neither integration nor disappearance there is no certainty only continued exposure to solitude note english is not my first language feedback on conceptual clarity is especially appreciated
